description: This PHP script manages build editing operations within the TestLink project, including creating, editing, deleting, and updating build entries, as well as rendering the related GUI components and handling user permissions.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for passing structured data between functions.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class instance for rendering GUI components.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Manager class for handling test plan related operations.

classes.name: build_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling build related database operations.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request and session parameters into an object for further processing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI data structure based on current arguments and build manager state.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing an existing build, populating form fields with current build info.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a new build, setting default values.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a build entry after permission and existence checks, logs the event.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Renders the build management GUI based on current action and data.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new build, including validation, database insertion, and copying assignments.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing build with new data, performs validation, and logs changes.

methods.name: crossChecks
methods.description: Performs validation checks for duplicate build names and valid release dates.

methods.name: doCopyToTestPlans
methods.description: Copies a build to other test plans within the same project, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for build creation rights.

methods.name: init_source_build_selector
methods.description: Initializes HTML options for selecting a source build when copying assignments.
